medical_text: MRI demonstrates mild bilateral neural foraminal stenosis at L4-L5 without evidence of acute cord compression.

medical_text: There is no focal consolidation, pleural effusion, or pneumothorax.

medical_text: The biopsy reveals benign fibrocystic changes with no evidence of malignancy.

medical_text: Mild cardiomegaly is present without pulmonary edema.

medical_text: Hemoglobin A1c is elevated at 8.2 percent, consistent with suboptimal glycemic control.

medical_text: There is degenerative disc disease at C5-C6 with mild central canal narrowing.

medical_text: No acute intracranial hemorrhage, mass effect, or midline shift is identified.

medical_text: Creatinine is mildly elevated, suggesting reduced renal function.

medical_text: The tympanic membrane is erythematous and bulging with decreased mobility on pneumatic otoscopy.

medical_text: Flexible laryngoscopy demonstrates mild vocal fold edema without lesions or airway compromise.
plain_language: A small camera exam of the throat shows mild swelling of the vocal cords. No growths are seen, and the airway does not look blocked.

medical_text: Audiogram reveals bilateral high-frequency sensorineural hearing loss.

medical_text: There is left maxillary sinus mucosal thickening with an air-fluid level.
plain_language: The scan shows swelling inside the left cheek sinus and fluid in that sinus. These findings can be seen with sinus inflammation or infection.

medical_text: Nasal endoscopy shows inferior turbinate hypertrophy and a rightward septal deviation.
plain_language: The nose exam shows enlarged nasal tissue and a nasal wall that bends toward the right. These can make it harder to breathe through the nose.

medical_text: The patient has tonsillar hypertrophy without peritonsillar abscess.

medical_text: CT temporal bone shows opacification of the mastoid air cells without bony erosion.

medical_text: There is conductive hearing loss with a type B tympanogram on the right.
plain_language: The hearing loss in the right ear appears related to sound not moving well through the outer or middle ear. The pressure test suggests fluid or poor eardrum movement.

medical_text: The epistaxis resolved after anterior nasal packing.

medical_text: There is no evidence of cholesteatoma on otomicroscopy.
